subject: Re: LumenPay SOC2 - onboarding & background evidence delivery
messages:
From: Diane Park <diane.park@lumenpay.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@lumenpay.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request - onboarding/background checks/training (SOC 2)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SOC 2 vendor assessment for LumenPay we need a concise package showing your employee onboarding/offboarding controls, background check coverage, and security training completion evidence for the last rolling 12 months. Specifically we need: 

- A short playbook or runbook that describes onboarding and offboarding steps (who signs off, access provisioning, timing).
- A redacted index of background checks (vendor + scope + date) showing coverage for all new hires in the last 12 months.
- A download (CSV or summary) of training completions for security awareness and role-based training for the last 12 months.
- Examples of access revocation logs or evidence that accounts are removed promptly at exit.
- Any SOP or automation you have for deprovisioning (scripts, ticketing flows).

If we can get these artifacts by COB next Tuesday (2026-09-22) that would keep our audit timeline intact. We can accept redacted personnel identifiers; vendor confirmations are fine. Let us know the expected file formats and if you need an NDA or additional PO information.

Best,
Diane
Diane Park
Head of Security Ops
LumenPay

--
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@lumenpay.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request - onboarding/background checks/training (SOC 2)

Hi Diane —

Thank you, and appreciate the clear list. We can produce a compact package that addresses each bullet. High-level plan and ETA below: 

1) Onboarding/Offboarding playbook (PDF) — includes approval gates, ticketing flow (Jira), and automation triggers. Target: 2026-09-18.
2) Background-check index (redacted PDF) — vendor (VeriCheck), scope fields, hire date; we will redact PII. Target: 2026-09-20.
3) Training completion export (CSV) — security awareness + role-based modules; will include anonymized user IDs and completion timestamps. Target: 2026-09-20.
4) Access revocation evidence (CSV + sample logs) — example entries showing deprovision timestamps vs termination date. Target: 2026-09-22.

Attachments will be redacted where necessary. I’ve looped in Neha (HR operations) and Lauren (Trust & Compliance) to coordinate the exports and redaction. If LumenPay requires signed attestations from our background-check vendor, we can request a letter from VeriCheck but that may take an extra 48–72 hours.

Do you prefer a single zip with readme, or individual files uploaded to a shared Drive folder? We can provide both; Drive link is easiest for iterative review.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request - onboarding/background checks/training (SOC 2)

Jonas — quick notes from HR ops on what we can and cannot include for redaction and timelines: 

- Background checks: we can share an index (name redacted to initials, candidate ID, vendor, check type, completion date). VeriCheck confirmation letters are available but require opt-in for disclosure; we will request a vendor attestation if LumenPay needs it.
- Training CSV: will include internal user_id, role, module, completion_date. We will remove email addresses and employee numbers.
- Onboarding playbook: attach the latest playbook v2.1 (no PII).
- Access revocation: we can provide the last 90 days of deprovision events from our identity provider (Okta) and a representative ticket export from Jira showing the offboard workflow.

Attachments I will prepare and upload to a shared Evidence folder: training-completions-2026-Q3-redacted.csv, background-verifications-index-redacted.pdf, onboarding-offboarding-playbook-v2.1.pdf, access-revocation-schedule-2026.xlsx, user-provisioning-change-log-2026-09.csv. Expect uploads by EOD Monday (2026-09-20).

Also flagged for the record: for personnel names we will use initials and a mapping key internally (not included in the export) to preserve privacy and meet LumenPay's evidence needs.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@lumenpay.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request - onboarding/background checks/training (SOC 2) — package delivery

Hi Diane —

We uploaded the requested evidence to a shared Drive folder and attached a brief readme that maps each file to your original bullets. Files included (redacted where noted):

- onboarding-offboarding-playbook-v2.1.pdf 
- background-verifications-index-redacted.pdf (names redacted to initials, vendor column present)
- training-completions-2026-Q3-redacted.csv (anonymized IDs, modules, completion timestamps)
- user-provisioning-change-log-2026-09.csv (Okta event exports)
- access-revocation-schedule-2026.xlsx (Jira ticket + timestamp crosswalk)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLinkOnboardingEvidence
HubSpot ticket: HS-42872

If LumenPay needs a vendor attestation from VeriCheck we can request a signed confirmation (estimate +48–72 hours). If you'd like a single password-protected zip instead of Drive, tell us the preferred transfer method and we’ll deliver.

Thanks — please confirm receipt and whether anything else is required for your SOC 2 assessment.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
